nodes.name: backend/Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Multi-stage Docker build for the backend Node.js application using node:22-alpine. The builder stage installs production dependencies, and the final stage copies node_modules and application code, runs as a non-root user, and starts server.js on port 5000.
nodes.languageNotes: Multi-stage build pattern separates dependency installation from runtime, reducing image size. Non-root user enhances security. Creates storage directories for avatars and mountain-photos at build time.

nodes.name: builder
nodes.summary: Builder stage that installs production Node.js dependencies using npm ci, then cleans the cache to reduce image size.

nodes.name: node
nodes.summary: Runtime stage that copies dependencies from the builder, sets up a non-root nodejs user, copies application code, creates storage directories, and starts the server on port 5000.
